Why it matters: the type is barrelled, so both sentences reach every consumer. What right looks like: restate src/core/types.ts:79-81 as an internal accumulator whose members are readonly and whose extraction path writes through Object.assign, and restate guides/msg.md:51 to match, dropping "mutable" and "(index-signature)" as the write channel. Do not intern the type and do not touch the barrel or the parity INTERNAL list — msg-obj-9 reserves that to the Orchestrator.
